spec.name: Zawiya Masbahiya Mosque
spec.description: The Zawiya Masbahiya is a significant religious landmark in Larache, dedicated to the Masbahi family. It is most famous for its association with Lalla Mennana al-Masbahiya, the city's patron saint. Local legend tells of her transformation into a white dove upon her death, and she remains a central figure in Larache's spiritual identity. The site is a focal point for the city's annual Moussem, celebrating her piety and legacy.

timeline.title: Rise of Masbahi Family
timeline.description: The Masbahi family gains prominence in the region for their resistance against foreign occupation.

timeline.title: Legacy of Lalla Mennana
timeline.description: Life and death of Lalla Mennana, establishing the site's spiritual importance.
